notes: Solana holder tables used: solana_utils.latest_balances (current state) and solana_utils.daily_balances (historical snapshots). Both queries use COALESCE(token_balance_owner, address) to handle delegated token accounts. AMM/pool exclusion: not implemented - Dune's Solana schema does not provide a reliable flag or join path to cleanly identify AMM liquidity pool token accounts vs real holders. The concentration metric includes all token-holding addresses regardless of whether they are pools, program accounts, or EOAs. This is a known limitation of the current implementation.

concentration.description: Top-N holder share of circulating supply. Returns 2 rows: 'now' (current) and 'baseline' (window_days ago). Value is a 0-1 float representing the fraction of total supply held by the top N holders.

whale_flow.description: Aggregate token balance held by top-N holders. Returns 2 rows: 'now' (current) and 'baseline' (window_days ago). Value is the absolute sum of token balances (not adjusted for decimals - raw on-chain balance).
